invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破78（基于ATR 0.8188和日线支撑），或融资费率Z-score转正>50%（轧多风险增加）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 78 (based on ATR 0.8188 and daily support), or funding Z-score turns positive >50% (long squeeze risk increases).

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破2080（基于ATR 18.6032和支撑），或融资费率Z-score转正>20%（轧空潜力消失）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 2080 (based on ATR 18.6032 and support), or funding Z-score turns positive >20% (short squeeze potential disappears).
